parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: The lens is a cylindrical optical component made of glass, located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It focuses light onto the camera sensor to capture images with clarity and precision.
parts.Movement_description: It may move slightly for zoom or focus adjustments, depending on the camera design.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the top of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main shutter button to capture photos.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed to trigger the camera mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary plastic button on the top surface of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It may control power or mode selection functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed to activate its assigned function.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another small plastic button on the camera body.
parts.Functional_description: It could be used for menu navigation or settings adjustment.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed to register input.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A plastic button located near the top or side of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a video record or playback control button.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed to perform its function.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button integrated into the camera body.
parts.Functional_description: It could be used for zoom control or menu navigation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed to register user input.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the camera made of aluminum alloy.
parts.Functional_description: It houses all internal components and provides structural integrity and protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the rigid frame of the camera.
